note: Whole verses of the Hebrew Bible that use only course words, placed in the first unit whose words and grammar they need (grammar read from the OSHB morphology). Hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex via the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible (text public domain, morphology CC BY 4.0), cantillation removed. English: World English Bible (public domain), with LORD written Yahweh. Only chapters with the same verse division in both are used. Written by build/davidson_corpus.py bible.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה יְהוָה שְׁמוֹ
verses.english: Yahweh is a man of war. Yahweh is his name.

verses.hebrew: הוּא יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָיו
verses.english: He is Yahweh our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן גָּדוֹל וְרָם הוּא עַל־כָּל־הָעַמִּים
verses.english: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־תִכְרֹת לָהֶם וְלֵאלֹהֵיהֶם בְּרִית
verses.english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

verses.hebrew: רָם עַל־כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְהוָה עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ
verses.english: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־מַלְכֵי גוֹיִם כֻּלָּם שָׁכְבוּ בְכָבוֹד אִישׁ בְּבֵיתוֹ
verses.english: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ עַל־הַשֻּׁלְחָן לֶחֶם פָּנִים לְפָנַי תָּמִיד
verses.english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

verses.hebrew: לֹא לָנוּ יְהוָה לֹא לָנוּ כִּי־לְשִׁמְךָ תֵּן כָּבוֹד עַל־חַסְדְּךָ עַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ
verses.english: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth's sake.

verses.hebrew: אֶתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בְּאַרְצוֹת הַחַיִּים
verses.english: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

verses.hebrew: רַק אֶת־דָּמוֹ לֹא תֹאכֵל עַל־הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּיִם
verses.english: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.

verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם
verses.english: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love Yahweh your God.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד דָּוִד אֶת־כָּל־בָּחוּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף
verses.english: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם צֹאן וּבָקָר וַיִּתֵּן לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיִּכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּרִית
verses.english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָן וַתִּקַּח־לוֹ אִמּוֹ אִשָּׁה מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם
verses.english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדְּךָ אָבִי אֵלֵינוּ אַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם כִּי שְׁנַיִם יָלְדָה־לִּי אִשְׁתִּי
verses.english: Your servant, my father, said to us, 'You know that my wife bore me two sons.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה אֶל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם
verses.english: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.

verses.hebrew: זֶה־הַשַּׁעַר לַיהוָה צַדִּיקִים יָבֹאוּ בוֹ
verses.english: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ הַבָּא בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה בֵּרַכְנוּכֶם מִבֵּית יְהוָה
verses.english: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh's name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh's house.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֲבַקֵּשׁ לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם הַבָּאִים עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם
verses.english: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן קָרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כִּי שָׁם נִשְׁבְּעוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם
verses.english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.

verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תֹאכֲלֶנּוּ שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר יְהוָה אַתָּה וּבֵיתֶךָ
verses.english: You shall eat it before Yahweh your God year by year in the place which Yahweh shall choose, you and your household.

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ בְּמִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִיד אָרֶץ וְאִישׁ תְּרוּמוֹת יֶהֶרְסֶנָּה
verses.english: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כָּל־יְמֵי חֲנוֹךְ חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה
verses.english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כָל־הָאָרֶץ שָׂפָה אֶחָת וּדְבָרִים אֲחָדִים
verses.english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ חַיֵּי שָׂרָה מֵאָה שָׁנָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְשֶׁבַע שָׁנִים שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי שָׂרָה
verses.english: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah's life.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֹּל יוֹסֵף עַל־פְּנֵי אָבִיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו וַיִּשַּׁק־לוֹ
verses.english: Joseph fell on his father's face, wept on him, and kissed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה אֶל־הָהָר וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת־הָהָר
verses.english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה בְּתוֹךְ הֶעָנָן וַיַּעַל אֶל־הָהָר וַיְהִי מֹשֶׁה בָּהָר אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה
verses.english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם אַלְפַּיִם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים
verses.english: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
verses.english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְחָמָה לֹא הָיָתָה עַד שְׁנַת־שְׁלֹשִׁים וְחָמֵשׁ לְמַלְכוּת אָסָא
verses.english: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa's reign.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹיָדָע בְּרִית בֵּינוֹ וּבֵין כָּל־הָעָם וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ לִהְיוֹת לְעָם לַיהוָה
verses.english: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be Yahweh's people.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהָמָן לִשְׁתּוֹת עִם־אֶסְתֵּר הַמַּלְכָּה
verses.english: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ שִׁמְךָ גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא קָדוֹשׁ הוּא
verses.english: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

verses.hebrew: יְהִי כְבוֹד יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם יִשְׂמַח יְהוָה בְּמַעֲשָׂיו
verses.english: Let Yahweh's glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי שֵׁם יְהוָה מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם
verses.english: Blessed be Yahweh's name, from this time forward and forever more.

verses.hebrew: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ
verses.english: They have mouths, but they don't speak. They have eyes, but they don't see.

verses.hebrew: בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַיהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ
verses.english: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

verses.hebrew: פִּתְחוּ־לִי שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶדֶק אָבֹא־בָם אוֹדֶה יָהּ
verses.english: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ כִּי עֲנִיתָנִי וַתְּהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה
verses.english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לֵאלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
verses.english: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.hebrew: עַל נַהֲרוֹת בָּבֶל שָׁם יָשַׁבְנוּ גַּם־בָּכִינוּ בְּזָכְרֵנוּ אֶת־צִיּוֹן
verses.english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

verses.hebrew: מַה־שֶּׁהָיָה הוּא שֶׁיִּהְיֶה וּמַה־שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה הוּא שֶׁיֵּעָשֶׂה וְאֵין כָּל־חָדָשׁ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ
verses.english: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אֵין טוֹב בָּם כִּי אִם־לִשְׂמוֹחַ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת טוֹב בְּחַיָּיו
verses.english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־עֲוֺנֹתֵיכֶם הָיוּ מַבְדִּלִים בֵּינֵכֶם לְבֵין אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶם הִסְתִּירוּ פָנִים מִכֶּם מִשְּׁמוֹעַ
verses.english: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׁבְתֶּם וּרְאִיתֶם בֵּין צַדִּיק לְרָשָׁע בֵּין עֹבֵד אֱלֹהִים לַאֲשֶׁר לֹא עֲבָדוֹ
verses.english: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn't serve him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי־אָדָם אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת־שֵׁת שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת
verses.english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־חָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָם בְּאַרְצֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶם
verses.english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־שֵׁם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָם בְּאַרְצֹתָם לְגוֹיֵהֶם
verses.english: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן־מְאַת שָׁנָה בְּהִוָּלֶד לוֹ אֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ
verses.english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְהוּדָה וְאֶחָיו בֵּיתָה יוֹסֵף וְהוּא עוֹדֶנּוּ שָׁם וַיִּפְּלוּ לְפָנָיו אָרְצָה
verses.english: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רָחֵל אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לְיַעֲקֹב כָּל־נֶפֶשׁ אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר
verses.english: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי־דָן חֻשִׁים
verses.english: The son of Dan: Hushim.

verses.hebrew: וְרָחֲצוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם
verses.english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

verses.hebrew: וְאַהֲרֹן בֶּן־שָׁלֹשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה בְּמֹתוֹ בְּהֹר הָהָר
verses.english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

verses.hebrew: מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן־יוֹסֵף הָיוּ לְנָשִׁים וַתְּהִי נַחֲלָתָן עַל־מַטֵּה מִשְׁפַּחַת אֲבִיהֶן
verses.english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶם
verses.english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶּן־עוֹדֵד הָיְתָה עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים
verses.english: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה יְהוֹרָם בְּמָלְכוֹ וּשְׁמוֹנֶה שָׁנִים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם
verses.english: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמָלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם
verses.english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד יְהוָה לִרְאֹת אֶת־הָעִיר וְאֶת־הַמִּגְדָּל אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ בְּנֵי הָאָדָם
verses.english: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח אֹתוֹת וּמֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵכִי מִצְרָיִם בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכָל־עֲבָדָיו
verses.english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

verses.hebrew: וְעוֹד רָאִיתִי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ מְקוֹם הַמִּשְׁפָּט שָׁמָּה הָרֶשַׁע וּמְקוֹם הַצֶּדֶק שָׁמָּה הָרָשַׁע
verses.english: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

verses.hebrew: רַק בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא הָיָה בָּרָד
verses.english: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה עִמּוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם עַל־מֵי מֵרוֹם פִּתְאֹם וַיִּפְּלוּ בָּהֶם
verses.english: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.
